title: Today’s US Open Tennis Matches: Listen Live on SiriusXM
summary: Follow the 2026 US Open with live match play-by-play from Flushing Meadows on SiriusXM.
body_markdown:
The 2026 US Open begins Sunday, August 30 with the first round of the men’s and women’s singles draws — and SiriusXM listeners can follow the action live from the USTA Billie Jean King National Tennis Center in Flushing, New York.


Throughout the tournament, listen to live US Open tennis coverage on satellite Ch. 392 and the[SiriusXM app](https://sxm.app.link/BlogUSOpenTennis) .


[US Open Tennis Live match play-by-play Listen on the App Listen on the App](https://sxm.app.link/BlogUSOpenTennis)


## 2026 US Open


### How to Listen to the US Open Live


Listen to live US Open match play-by-play on satellite Ch. 392 and[the SiriusXM app with your smart device](https://sxm.app.link/BlogUSOpenTennis) .


### Today’s US Open Matches


The men’s and women’s singles first round begins Sunday, August 30.
